import sys

def modulo(a, b, c):
    return pow(a, b, c)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    d = r - l + 1
    a = d // 2
    b = d - a
    nm = n * m
    mod = 998244353
    ans = (modulo(a + b, nm, mod) + modulo(abs(a - b), nm, mod)) % mod
    ans = (ans * modulo(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = modulo(d, nm, mod)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
